AI is coming for my job. What should I do?

Behind that question is a bigger one I hear everywhere:

How should I think, act and navigate my life in the age of AI?

I see three responses.

Ignore it.
“Let’s see what happens.”

Fear it.
“There is nothing I can do.”

Or:

Own it.
“Change is coming. How do I make it work for me? How do I win?”

This conversation is for the third group.

Sunny asked me some of the best questions I have been asked about AI and our future. Interestingly, we spent very little time talking about machines.
We talked about you.

What will become less valuable?
What will become more valuable?
What should you learn — and unlearn?
What will happen to jobs, experience and hierarchy?
And what can you start doing today to stay relevant tomorrow?

My answer is not “don’t worry.”

My answer is:

There is a way to win in the age of AI. And you can.

Not by becoming more like a machine.
By becoming more of what makes you uniquely human.

Watch the full conversation here: https://lnkd.in/dBTXm3cs

If you know someone anxious or uncertain about what AI means for their future, please share this with them.

And if you disagree with me, tell me why. This conversation is too important not to have.

Sunny Sen 

#HumansFirst #HumansFirstMachinesSecond #HFMS #AI #FutureOfWork #StayInspired
